title: 1983 Donruss - #340 Gary Carter Expos
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Own a piece of baseball history with this 1983 Donruss trading card featuring legendary athlete Gary Carter of the Montreal Expos. This card, part of the base set, is numbered 340 and is a must-have for any sports trading card collector. The card is in excellent condition and has been kept in a protective sleeve to ensure its quality over time.

This card is perfect for fans of Major League Baseball and the Montreal Expos. The Donruss manufacturer is known for creating high-quality sports trading cards, and this card is no exception. Add it to your collection today and celebrate the legacy of one of the greatest catchers to ever play the game.
